comparisonRule: User-approved product changes pause file reading and population, retain manual intake, and use Home focus tabs. Existing extraction assertions remain conditional on the canonical autofill flag; the disabled branch verifies absent extraction UI/fields, unchanged manual identity, exact original bytes, and continued manual edits. All other chart, files, scheduling, history, separate-referral upload and save assertions execute. Home journeys explicitly select the relevant tab. Case/title counts, API digest, and critical conflict digest are unchanged; assertion count increases. This is product behavior evidence, not a refactor coverage waiver.
